title: Verify Python TX paths enforce admission constraints
description:
Scope: focused actual-path admission tests under /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/python/tests/link/ and necessary existing node/simulator test fixtures. Drive the completed production Python scheduler/link/forwarding interfaces through every applicable independently specified admission-supplement case in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/. Capture real radio submission and accounting state for normal, retry, control, fallback and SOS paths. A hardware-event double may record calls but cannot manufacture admission decisions or expected totals. Production defects go to their implementation owners.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse existing LinkLayer/node radio fixtures and thin case dispatch; do not rewrite production logic in tests. Depend on completed python.14 and vectors.12 rather than the language parent or joined CI completion.
acceptance_criteria: Focused pytest and affected legacy link/simulator suites run successfully with exact expected/consumed supplement IDs. Constraint violations produce no actual radio TX call, including priority/control/fallback paths. Emitted events, alias/group accounts, post-CCA rechecks, restart continuity and callback outcomes match independent frozen expectations. Unknown/missing/empty scenarios fail. Relevant ruff checks pass; no helper-only result or TX completion is presented as delivery or RF approval.
